summary.decision_summary: Sigma Chi Whiteout won by 55.1. Sigma Chi Whiteout left 20.8 lineup points on the table, while ZSzizzle left 4.3.
summary.historical_summary: This is the first recorded meeting between these managers. Sigma Chi Whiteout leads the manager series 1-0.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Sigma Chi Whiteout
summary.winner_reason: Sigma Chi Whiteout won by 55.1, led by a 34.1-point edge at WR. The leading starters were Kenneth Walker III (40.3) and Matthew Golden (29.4).
summary.loser_reason: ZSzizzle could not match the opponent's WR production, losing that position battle by 34.1 points. Patriots scored -1.0. A best legal lineup added 4.3, still short of the 55.1-point margin.

summary.winner_reason: Pat Pidgeon won by 20.5 after scoring -25.8 against projection. The leading starters were Dak Prescott (21.3) and Jahmyr Gibbs (18.4).
summary.loser_reason: In Purdytory lost by 20.5 while finishing 26.2 below projection. Jameson Williams scored 5.0. A best legal lineup added 10.8, still short of the 20.5-point margin.
